title: Halo's Next Chapter: A Famous Game Hero Changes Hands Again
summary:
Master Chief, the armoured hero of the Halo video games, is facing a big change. Halo is a famous science-fiction game series, but it is changing hands again, and fans wonder if its best days are over.

Halo began in 2001. It was created by a studio called Bungie. After Bungie left, a new team took over. That team is now called Halo Studios. According to the writer, Halo 4 and Halo 5 did not really move the series forward. Halo Infinite did better, but it still fell short of the glory days.

This year, Xbox released Halo: Campaign Evolved, a remake of the first game's story. The writer calls it perfectly fine, but not the rescue Halo needs.

Now, Activision, the company behind Call of Duty, is taking over the games. Rumours suggest there may be a reboot that retells Master Chief's origins. In May 2026, insider Rebs Gaming reported that remakes of Halo 2 and Halo 3 were also in development. For now, Master Chief's future is cloudier than ever.
why_it_matters: If you play video games, a favourite series changing hands can mean the next games in it could look and feel quite different.
